countdown.title: The IMT Atlantique Forum starts in:

school.title: IMT Atlantique – A School of Excellence
school.description1: IMT Atlantique is a top French engineering school formed from the merger of Télécom Bretagne and Mines Nantes. It trains engineers, researchers, and entrepreneurs shaping the technologies of the future.
school.description2: With campuses in Brest, Nantes, and Rennes, the school combines cutting-edge research, innovation, and global openness. It plays a key role in the digital, energy, and environmental transitions.
school.footer: 🌍 A school focused on the future and the challenges of the 21st century.

groupPhoto.alt: Group photo of IMT Atlantique students

forum.title: Meet more than 40 partner companies!
forum.description1: Born from the desire of students to create a direct link with companies, Cap Carrières is a forum conceived as a genuine space for exchange.
forum.description2: This student initiative aims to foster concrete encounters centered on internships, employment, and career prospects. The event allows companies to meet young talents who are curious, competent, committed, and ready to take on the challenges of tomorrow.
forum.footer: 🤝 Join us for a day rich in exchanges, learning, and career opportunities!
